scope: Dry/wet comparison matrix, Tier A (runs under the existing native_geometry_recovery named-case depth once its case_set entry is wired). Controlled variables: same car, same track (0), same lap count (1), same AI precision mode, zero rivals; ONLY weather and starting compound vary between cells of a row. Water accumulates from the weather profile's initialWater and evolves during the lap. Cross-case comparisons are computed afterwards from mounted-native-layout-results.json; direction expectations below are checks for the analyst, not machine-enforced gates. The already-completed Rain/Medium-slick cell (run 41625514977, cars 0+16, WET_SLICK_COMPARISON_ACTUAL.json) is deliberately NOT repeated here.

cases.note: Clear profile, initialWater 0; baseline for the row
initialWater 0, so physical grip equals dry_reference by construction; controls for visual/atmosphere differences only
Rain profile (initialWater 0.55, rain continues), Wet compound

alreadyCompletedCells.scope: These cells are already measured and must NOT be listed under cases (they would be re-run); they are recorded here so each row is complete.

expectedOrderings.scope: Direction-only checks for the analyst comparing mounted-native-layout-results.json across cells of one car row. Ordering claims, never magnitude claims; failure of a direction is a finding to investigate, not something to tune away silently.
perCarComparisons: lapTime(dry_reference) < lapTime(wet_wet_tyre) < lapTime(wet_slick): wet laps slower on the same compound family, and slicks slower still in the wet
lapTime(dry_reference) ~ lapTime(overcast_control): initialWater is 0 in both, so any pace difference beyond run noise indicates an unintended weather coupling

alreadyCompletedEvidence.wet_slick_cells: run 41625514977 (Rain2/Medium1, cars 0+16): slick slower by 16.979185 s (car 0) and 1.849546 s (car 16) versus prior Wet3 reference 41620748966
alreadyCompletedEvidence.caveat: Those runs confirm sensitivity, not real-world calibration (see instructions.md section 5)
